spec.description: A dashboard to visualize application's deployment.

panels.description: CPU usage of pods in a specified namespace
panels.title: CPU Core Usage by $service

panels.description: request rate per minute over last 1 minutes

targets.expr: sum by(span_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service="$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_route=~"$route", rems_environment="$env"}[1m]))

panels.title: Request Rate

panels.description: CPU throttling ratio for each container within a specific application in a Kubernetes namespace.

targets.expr: sum(increase(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", pod=~"^$name.*$", container!="", cluster="$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) by (container) /sum(increase(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", pod=~"^$service.*$", container!="", cluster="$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) by (container)

panels.title: CPU Throttling

panels.description: by route and http status code

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service="$service", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", http_route=~"$route", rems_environment="$env"}[1m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name="$service", route=~"$route"}[1m])))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name="$service", route=~"$route"}[1m])))

panels.title: Latency $route

panels.description: it showing the total memory used by pods for a specific deployment.
panels.title: Memory Usage -$service

panels.description: It shows the percentage of successful and unsuccessful HTTP requests for a specific route within an application

targets.expr:
(
  sum(
    rate(
      traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{
        rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup",
        rems_service="$service",
        rems_environment="$env",
        span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",
        http_status_code!~"^2.*|^3.*",
        rpc_grpc_status_code="",
        http_status_code!="",
        http_route=~"$route"
      }[5m]
    ) or on() vector(0)
  )
  +
  sum(
    rate(
      traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{
        rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup",
        rems_service="$service",
        rems_environment="$env",
        span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",
        rpc_grpc_status_code!~"^0$",
        http_status_code="",
        rpc_grpc_status_code!="",
        http_route=~"$route"
      }[5m]
    ) or on() vector(0)
  )
)
* 100
/
sum(
  rate(
    traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{
      span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",
      rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup",
      rems_service="$service",
      rems_environment="$env",
      http_route=~"$route"
    }[5m]
  )
)

panels.title: Success/Error Rate of $route

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by(http_route) (traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service="$service", rems_environment="$env"}))

topk(10, sum by(http_route) (traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service="$service", rems_environment="$env"})) / (sum by(http_route) (traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service="$service", rems_environment="$env"}))

panels.description: This will give logs of  services  for selected times range

targets.expr: {application_group="$ApplicationGroup", rems_service="$service" ,rems_environment="$env"} |= `$search` | json | line_format `{{.log}}`

panels.title: Logs

targets.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor",cluster="$cluster", image!="",container!="",container=~"$container",pod=~"^$service.*$"}[5m])) by (pod, container)

panels.description: It will display traces(max 1000) within the specified time frame that have a duration of more than 150ms.
panels.title: Application Traces

defaults.noValue: No Events in this time range

targets.expr: {service_name="kube-events"} | k8s_object_name=~"$service.*"
count by(alertname, severity, namespace, pod) (ALERTS{alertgroup="Servicehealth.rules", rems_application_group=~"$ApplicationGroup", rems_environment=~"$env", rems_service=~"$service"})
